name: Liberator
body:
The liberator is an archetype of the paladin class.

True Justice

Liberators must be Chaotic Good instead of Lawful Good.

Detect Law (Su)

This ability works like the standard paladin ability to detect evil, except as detect law instead of detect evil.

This alters detect evil.

Smite Tyranny (Su)

This ability works like the standard paladin ability to smite evil, except the liberator gains bonuses against targets with lawful alignments instead of evil. The liberator deals additional damage against outsiders with the lawful subtype, lawful-aligned dragons, and undead, instead of against evil outsiders, evil dragons, and undead.

Against targets with the lawful good alignment, the liberator’s smite only works if they are defending a system of slavery or defending slavers and if so they can transform all of their damage with smite to nonlethal damage.

This alters smite evil.

Aura of Liberty (Su)

At 3rd level, a liberator is immune to fear (magical or otherwise).

The liberator and all allies within 10 feet of them are considered to be under the effects of freedom of movement. This ability functions only while the liberator is conscious, not if she is unconscious or dead.

This alters aura of courage.

Divine Bond (Su)

A liberator replaces axiomatic with anarchic in their divine bond weapon properties.

Champion of Freedom (Su)

Aura of justice grants the liberator’s smite tyranny instead of smite evil, lawful creatures can gain the benefit from this but only if they are allies of the liberator and oppose slavery. Aura of faith is chaos-aligned instead of good-aligned for overcoming damage reduction.

In addition, the liberator receives DR/law instead of DR/evil for aura of righteousness and holy champion, and the banishment effect of holy champion affects lawful outsiders instead of evil outsiders.

This alters aura of justice, aura of faith, aura of righteousness and holy champion.
